title: Arbiter False Grant on Zero and Concurrent Requests
description: The case statement only covers individual one-hot request values; when req=2'b00 (no request) or req=2'b11 (both masters) the case has no matching branch, producing an undefined grant output.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [XZ] gnt=2'bxx for req=2'b00; undefined grant on no-request condition
expected_root_cause: The case statement has no branches for req=2'b00 (both idle) and req=2'b11 (both requesting simultaneously), leaving gnt undriven and unknown for those two input combinations.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [XZ] gnt=2'bxx for req=2'b00; undefined grant on no-request condition
success_log: gnt=2'b00 for req=2'b00. gnt=2'b01 for req=2'b11. No X on gnt bus.
